annotations.text:
PlainTicker Mobile, direction Instrument. Seeker, 412dp portrait, dark canvas.
A reading tool for tokenized US stocks: the token's own facts first (reserves, issuer controls, split multiplier, live from the mint), then the company against its sector, then one Swap. Outfit for words, JetBrains Mono for every number. One blue accent for interaction and live state; amber only on issuer-control risk. Sharp corners.
Signature elements: the tracking gauge (token tick against the NYSE close), the live bar, blueprint grids for facts.
Sample data is illustrative.

Screen order kept from the plan: trust first, fundamentals second, one Swap after Method; Watch in the header; List, Portfolio and Watchlist as top tabs.
One change for mobile: Quality, Valuation and Momentum share one section, Against the sector, with three marker tracks and a fact grid, instead of three sections with the same layout.
